premise: The forest band cannot play together until Woodpecker taps a beat on the old tree that everyone can follow.
inspiration: The Bremen Town Musicians (Grimm), turned: the band never leaves home, and what it was missing was not a stage but a shared rhythm.
lesson: Listening to each other is what makes music together.
learning: Woodpeckers drum on trees to talk to each other

en-US.title: Woodpecker Keeps the Beat
en-US.text: {bird:float loop 0.3} The forest band wanted to play a song. [excited] One, two, three, GO! Frog {frog:hop} sang ribbit. Bee {bee:shake} hummed bzzz. Bird {bird:pulse} whistled tweet. {all:wobble} But everyone went at a different speed. Ribbit-bzzz-tweet-ribbit-tweet! {frog:face surprised} {bee:face surprised} [giggles] What a muddle. Then Woodpecker {woodpecker:pulse} flew to the old tree. [curious] Listen, he said. {woodpecker:live} {sfx:tap-tap} Tap, tap, tap. He listened. He shook the dust off his head and chirped. Far away, another woodpecker drummed back. {sfx:far-drum solo} {woodpecker:face happy} [whispers] That's my cousin saying hello, said Woodpecker. Now, follow my taps. Tap, ribbit. Tap, bzzz. Tap, tweet. {all:face happy} [happily] And the forest band played its song {frog:hearts} {bee:hearts} all together, all afternoon long.

es-ES.title: El pájaro carpintero marca el ritmo
es-ES.text: {bird:float loop 0.3} La banda del bosque quería tocar una canción. [excited] ¡Un, dos, tres, YA! Rana {frog:hop} cantó croac. Abeja {bee:shake} zumbó bzzz. Pájaro {bird:pulse} silbó pío. {all:wobble} Pero cada uno iba a su velocidad. ¡Croac-bzzz-pío-croac-pío! {frog:face surprised} {bee:face surprised} [giggles] Menudo lío. Entonces el pájaro carpintero {woodpecker:pulse} voló hasta el viejo árbol. [curious] Escuchad, dijo. {woodpecker:live} {sfx:tap-tap} Toc, toc, toc. Escuchó. Se sacudió el polvo de la cabeza y pió. A lo lejos, otro pájaro carpintero le contestó con su tamborileo. {sfx:far-drum solo} {woodpecker:face happy} [whispers] Es mi primo, que me saluda, dijo el carpintero. Ahora, seguid mis toques. Toc, croac. Toc, bzzz. Toc, pío. {all:face happy} [happily] Y la banda del bosque tocó su canción {frog:hearts} {bee:hearts} todos juntos, toda la tarde.

tap-tap.prompt: a woodpecker tapping three quick light knocks on a hollow tree trunk

far-drum.prompt: a distant woodpecker drumming a quick soft rat-a-tat on a far-away tree
